sql_templates.description: Fetch sectors with improving breadth and stage participation in the last 20 sessions.
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_snapshots AS (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS latest_date FROM scores.stage_snapshots),
breadth_data AS (
    SELECT 
        sd.sector, 
        sd.pct_above_50dma,
        ma.stage2_pct
    FROM 
        breadth.sector_daily sd
    JOIN 
        breadth.ma_pct_above ma ON sd.snapshot_date = ma.snapshot_date
    WHERE 
        sd.snapshot_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '20 days')
),
stage_2_sectors AS (
    SELECT 
        ss.sector,
        COUNT(ss.symbol) AS stage_2_count
    FROM 
        scores.stage_snapshots ss
    WHERE 
        ss.stage = 'STAGE_2' AND 
        ss.snapshot_date = (SELECT latest_date FROM latest_snapshots)
    GROUP BY 
        ss.sector
)
SELECT 
    bd.sector,
    bd.pct_above_50dma,
    stage_2_count
FROM 
    breadth_data bd
LEFT JOIN 
    stage_2_sectors s2 ON bd.sector = s2.sector
ORDER BY 
    pct_above_50dma DESC, 
    stage_2_count DESC 
LIMIT 10;
sql_templates.title: Sector Breadth and Stage Participation
